title: LoopZeroKit services.json (v1)
description: Platform-neutral services manifest emitted by `loopzerokit build`. Mirror of loopzerokit/packages/loopzero/src/services/adapters-bridge/manifest.ts ServicesManifest interface. Plan B v3.1 T-B.3 + ADR-0015 (platform-neutral).

runtime.description: Runtime that owns the service process. Maps to LanguageStrategy via Plan B v3.1 T-B.4 runtimeToStrategy table.

proxy.description: Non-empty path segment after `/`; cannot be `/` (would catch-all and conflict with LoopZeroKit routing).

env.description: Process environment variables passed to the running service. Keys MUST be POSIX-compliant (^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$); values are bounded to 4096 chars. Total entries capped at 64 to prevent manifest-bomb DoS. Plan v1.2 T1.3 — additional Go-side blocklist rejects reserved keys (PATH, HOME, LD_PRELOAD, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, KUBERNETES_*, LOOPZERO_*).
